table.$description: Tokens for Table: rows of the same facts, compared column by column (decision 47). Measured from the audit's capture of the office property page's All Available Spaces (F24 Data table; desktop 1700px).

font-weight.$description: OBSERVED: column headings at 400, values at 100; both 400 now (decision 4).

padding-block.$description: OBSERVED: 44px rows (28px text, 3px padding, centred in the row); became 8px above and below, giving 43px rows plus the 1px line.

padding-block-action.$description: PROPOSED: 4px above and below a cell that holds a button (Details, 32px), so its row stays 44px like the others, as AcmeCo's chevron cell does.

padding-inline.$description: OBSERVED: 20px at the row's ends; became 16px, the page gutter, as on Breadcrumbs.

background.$description: OBSERVED: a #ebebeb header bar; became #ededed, the nearest grey on the scale.

radius.$description: OBSERVED: 4px corners on the header bar.

border.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #dddddd lines left, right and under each row; became the system's default border (#e5e5e5). Decorative.

hover.$description: PROPOSED: a grey row on hover, as the site menu's rows, so a row that opens its details looks pressable. Not observed.

color.$description: PROPOSED: the system's focus ring, inside the row or cell (AcmeCo's rows can't take focus).
